messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Fluoxetine is FDA-approved to treat the following conditions:
- Major depressive disorder (MDD) for acute and maintenance treatment in adults and children aged 8 years and older
- Obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD) for acute and maintenance treatment in adults and children aged 7 years and older
- Bulimia nervosa for acute and maintenance treatment of binge-eating and purging in adults with moderate to severe bulimia
- Panic disorder for the treatment of panic attacks in adults
When used in combination with olanzapine, fluoxetine is also FDA-approved for:
- Acute treatment of depressive episodes associated with Bipolar I disorder (depressive episodes) in adults and children aged 10 years and older
- Treatment-resistant depression for adults who have not responded to at least two adequate antidepressant trials
Fluoxetine alone is not approved for bipolar I depressive episodes or treatment-resistant depression - olanzapine must be used in combination for these indications.
Triplet: ["Fluoxetine", "fda approved for", "Panic disorder"]

The relation 'fda approved for' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is approved by the FDA for the treatment of the medical condition specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'treats': The subject drug is used to treat or manage the disease or medical condition specified by the object entity.
B. 'fda approval year': The subject drug was approved by the US FDA in the year specified by the object entity.
C. 'used in population': The subject drug is used in or approved for the patient population or age group specified by the object entity.
D. 'used in': The subject drug is utilized in the medical procedure or clinical context specified by the object entity.
E. 'manufactured by': The subject drug is manufactured or marketed by the company specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
